title: Strengthening Your Relationship with God (Prayer)
description: A lesson on how to pray, grow in communication with God, and understand how He answers prayer.

cards.heading: Sharing Your Experience with God
cards.scriptureText: I love the Lord, for he heard my voice; he heard my cry for mercy.
cards.body: Share your experience of listening to God during the past week. Encourage your disciple to share what they have learned from their time with God, especially through Scripture.
cards.question: How has your time with God been this past week?

cards.heading: Reviewing God’s Word
cards.scriptureText: Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.
cards.body: Review previously learned verses together. These help strengthen your understanding of God’s promises, especially about prayer and relationship with Him.
cards.question: What do these verses teach you about your relationship with God?

cards.heading: What Is Prayer?
cards.scriptureText: Call to me and I will answer you.
cards.body: Prayer is talking to God. It is a personal relationship where you can freely express your thoughts, needs, and gratitude to Him.
cards.question: How do you currently approach prayer in your life?

cards.heading: A Simple Pattern for Prayer
cards.scriptureText: I will extol the Lord at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.
cards.body: A helpful way to pray is through the PART pattern: Praise God, Admit your sins, Request your needs, and Thank Him for everything. This keeps your prayer balanced and meaningful.
cards.question: Which part of prayer do you find easiest or most difficult?

cards.heading: Confession and Forgiveness
cards.scriptureText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us.
cards.body: Admitting our sins to God is an important part of prayer. He is faithful to forgive and cleanse us when we come to Him sincerely.
cards.question: Why is it important to be honest with God about your sins?

cards.heading: Trusting God with Your Needs
cards.scriptureText: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.
cards.body: God invites you to bring all your needs to Him. You can trust Him with every concern, big or small.
cards.question: What is something you need to bring to God in prayer today?

cards.heading: Giving Thanks to God
cards.scriptureText: Always giving thanks to God the Father for everything.
cards.body: Thanksgiving is an important part of prayer. It reminds us of God’s goodness and builds a grateful heart.
cards.question: What are you thankful to God for today?

cards.heading: God Answers Prayer
cards.scriptureText: Your Father knows what you need before you ask him.
cards.body: God answers prayer in different ways: sometimes He says yes, sometimes no, sometimes wait, and sometimes He gives something better than what we expected.
cards.question: Can you remember a time when God answered your prayer?

cards.heading: Growing in Prayer
cards.body: Prayer is something we grow in over time. Be patient, consistent, and sincere as you develop your relationship with God.
cards.question: What step can you take to grow in your prayer life this week?

cards.heading: Next Steps
cards.scriptureText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us.
cards.body: Set your next meeting and continue practicing prayer daily. Make time to talk to God and grow in your relationship with Him.
cards.question: How will you apply what you learned about prayer this week?
